title: Impact of premastectomy versus postmastectomy radiotherapy on postoperative complications in breast reconstruction: A systematic review and meta-analysis.

answer.design_quote: For dichotomous outcomes, pooled risk ratios (RRs) with corresponding 95% CIs were calculated to compare complication rates between patients receiving PreMRT and those receiving PMRT.
answer.k_quote: Three studies, including one randomized-controlled trial and two cohort studies comprising a total of 483 breasts were included in the meta-analysis.
